entity: West Virginia water systems' unresolved serious defects vs the rest of the country
what_we_add: the defect-case metric: 19% of pre-2022 cases still open vs 3% elsewhere, plus the Louisiana and EPA Region 9 comparisons and 2+ year counts
why: The Gazette-Mail names WV and states the same finding same direction: worst-in-US violation rate and 50.7% of systems on the unresolved-serious-violations priority list. Our unfixed-inspection-defect share and the LA/Region 9 numbers appear nowhere.
